parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it), 1-128 printable ASCII characters. The key is global, not per route. A repeat with the same key, method, path and body replays the first answer with the Idempotency-Replayed header set to "true" when that answer is final (a 2xx, or a refusal the same request cannot pass later); a different request under the same key is a 409 idempotency-key-reused. A refusal that a retry could pass (the RETRYABLE problem types of the API description) and a 5xx are not stored; the key is released, the retry under the same key executes again, and a different body under a released key is a new request.
